{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] '''''Dark Star''''' arrived as [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] group [[Qiluiy|Quluiy]] were making their way to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] following an attack by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The ''Dark Star'' and its fighters were unable to stop the corvettes, as were a group of Assault Gunboats that arrived after the Pirates were fended off.
